newsitem.title: USA: All-Comm files for 1.5 mln share offer.
newsitem.headline: All-Comm files for 1.5 mln share offer.

text.p: All-Comm Media Corp said it filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission for a proposed public offering of 1.5 million shares. The lead underwriter in the offering is L.T. Lawrence & Co Inc.

The offering will include 1.4 million common shares offered by the company and 100,000 by certain selling shareholders. The company said it and certain stockholders will also make shares available at the option of underwriters to cover any over-allotments.

Proceeds to the company from the offering will be used to invest in technology, technical support, sales and marketing personnel, advertising and promotion, and possibly to pay down debt related to the recent acquisition of Metro Services Group Inc.
